_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 1% breakout rate over 12h windows and the analyst's 0-for-18 record on forced directional calls in coils make HOLD the statistically honest default — the market is flushing but lacks the capital formation to advance up the ladder.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both see risk-off panic and a bottom analog, but the analyst's forward call of Disbelief is illegal (two rungs up) and the narrative implies continued bleeding rather than recovery, so consensus forward is Denial with HOLD direction.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 and stablecoin growth turns positive with funding staying below 60
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay near 0 and VIX breaks above 70 with BTC momentum rolling over below 40
